2604.20133 EvoAgent (sol 41.25 / son55 28.75): final 28.75. M, X and E.measurement → son55 1. Opus findings: (1) the paper says skill maturity grants 'higher priority in future matching', but Stage 1 returns the first keyword hit and Stage 2 takes the cosine argmax, so maturity never enters matching; (2) Appendix A increments usage_count but never writes success_rate, and success is not defined; (3) the declared length/ROUGE checks are never reported and the judge model is not named. RS: adapt_via_conditioning plus decompose_and_delegate supporting (son55, low fit). Domain: H02 only (sol); H01's edit-operation condition is absent. evidence_level task, scoped (both).

2604.20714 TPGO (sol 61.25 / son55 53.75): final 53.75. M → son55 2. Opus finding: the implementation edits a JSON section tree by node rewrite, insert and delete only; the edge operations of §4.3 do not appear in it, so 'structure-aware graph' optimisation reduces to sectioned-prompt editing. E.holdout → son55 1. The main tables are on the optimised task sets, and the GAIA reflector sees the gold answers of the reported tasks. The only held-out test is Table 4: +1.8 to +3.1 pp in a single run at temperature 1.0. Shared omission: GAIA overall pass@1 cannot be reproduced from the per-level rates and the stated 49/71/22 split (72.8 vs 73.8 baseline, 80.7 vs 81.6 after 5 iterations), although the gain is about the same size. RS → heterogeneous_decomposition primary plus adapt_via_conditioning supporting for GRAO. Domain → H09 plus H03 (sol).

2604.21003 Last Harness (sol 27.5 / son55 23.75): final 23.75. G → son55 1, because nearest-neighbour positioning is a single APO citation. A1 applied by both seats and checked: no experiments, so the five E items are not_reported 0 with search scope, and there is no formal result. evidence_level null (son55's 'none' normalised), claim_support unsupported. 2604.21725 AEL (sol 58.75 / son55 68.75): final 62.5. G → son55 3. X → sol 2: the core evolution trigger and the admission path contradict each other across §3.4, §3.5, App S and App P.2 (window-gated average-reward trigger vs a single-loss trigger at episode 84; the same RegimeFilteredRetrieval at seed 42 ep 84 vs seed 123 ep 95; admission 'by LinUCB' although memory arms are Thompson arms). On top of this, App N vs §3.1 disagree on the planner pool, and App W runs training past 140 bars. E.measurement → sol 3: verifiers are objective, and sample size belongs to E.statistics under A2. E.causality → sol 2: reflection alone sees market side information, the new support-ticket arm is privileged by construction, diagnose-before-prescribe is never ablated, and the reflection contrast has p=.384. Shared omission: HyperAgent is 0.72±0.38 in Table 2/5 but 0.46±0.41 in App J/K/Table 16, and the abstract's 'lowest variance among all stochastic methods' is false against either value. RS → reframe_as_solvable_object plus adapt_via_conditioning (son55). Domain → H21 plus H05 (son55).

2604.25850 AHE (sol 67.5 / son55 70.0): final 65.0. X → sol 3. Algorithm 1 evaluates H_{t-1} but stores H_t as best. Rollback is called automatic (§3.3, App C.3), yet the Evolve prompt makes it a KEEP / IMPROVE / ROLLBACK judgement, and after the 75.8→73.0 drop at iteration 7 the agent patched instead of rolling back. E.holdout → son55 2. Shared omission: the headline 77.0% is the in-loop iteration-8 score (76.97 = 137/178 at k=2), i.e. the best of 10 noisy evaluations on the selection set. The ACE and TF-GRPO cells imply k=3 (91.7% = 11/12; 48.9% = 44/90; 79.4% = 131/165; 55.6% = 50/90). The only independent-task evidence (SWE-bench-verified) is +0.4 pp success with 12% fewer tokens. RS → decompose_and_delegate/C25 primary plus generative_process_redesign supporting. Domain → H12 only (sol); H31's statistically sound commit rule is absent.
